title: Tick Size, Trading Strategies and Market Quality
authors: Ingrid M. Werner; Barbara Rindi; Sabrina Buti; Yuanji Wen
near_miss_reason: Stacked-only design. The TSE tick-size reductions for TOPIX100 stocks on 2014-01-14 and 2014-07-22 are two cohorts, but TSE_DataPrep stacks two separate event windows (Nov 2013-Mar 2014; May-Sep 2014) with cohort-coded stock identifiers (security2 = security3 + 90000 for July) and absorbs security2 + date FE (Table 6, TSE and Fragulator panels). In the shipped data all 57 January controls are July-treated stocks and 11 stocks are treated in both events, so an unstacked panel would have repeated treatment and no common window. The US Tick Size Pilot panel is a single-date design (pilot end, 2018-10-01).
main_or_robustness: main (empirical test of the model, Table 6)
eligible_reason: No column satisfies every rule. TSE (Table 6): stacked event-by-event panels with stock-cohort and date FE (reghdfe y Pilot EVENT EVENTPilot, absorb(security2 date)); subsamples by tick-constrained status (Low/High) and a triple difference with Low. USTSP (Table 6): single common date (Oct 1, 2018) G1 vs control stocks with ric and date FE, plus a triple difference on tick-constrained status.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe). TSE outcomes spread, pspread2, ldepth, lvolume, Fragulator Share_TSE; USTSP outcomes pspread_wt2, logdepth_wt2, loglitvolume, litshare. Clustered by stock and date.

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked design (stock-cohort FE security2); two non-overlapping event windows; repeated treatment for 11 stocks
stacked design; subsamples by tick-constrained status
single common date (pilot end 2018-10-01); not staggered

data_files_note: Readme.pdf: processed regression panels shipped with only the variables used (TSE 17,391 stock-days, 187 stock-cohorts from 100 stocks; USTSP 96,343 stock-days); raw TRTH/DTAQ data licensed.
data_provenance_note: Authors' processed analysis panels from TRTH, Fragulator and DTAQ; no synthetic or sampling statement.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF; OpenAlex abstract empty). Stacked-only near-miss (two TSE cohorts); data shipped.
